```{r}
#| include: false
if (!exists("CAP", inherits = FALSE)) {
  CAP <- paste(
    "Five-percent-damped pseudoacceleration spectra for product %s at",
    "predictive level p=%s. The panel fixes Q=%s kg; each curve is the",
    "pointwise median of %s realizations for the indicated distance.",
    "Tn=0 corresponds to PGA."
  )
}

SCENARIO.CFG.FILE <- file.path(root, "scripts", "runScenarios.json")
SCENARIO.CFG <- jsonlite::read_json(
  SCENARIO.CFG.FILE,
  simplifyVector = TRUE
)
SCENARIO.CFG.REQ <- c(
  "InputID", "D.grid", "MIC.grid", "P", "D50", "nTheta"
)
if (length(setdiff(SCENARIO.CFG.REQ, names(SCENARIO.CFG)))) {
  stop("scenarios.PSA.qmd: runScenarios.json is incomplete.", call. = FALSE)
}
SCENARIO.INPUT.CFG <- as.character(SCENARIO.CFG$InputID)
SCENARIO.D.CFG <- as.numeric(SCENARIO.CFG$D.grid)
SCENARIO.Q.CFG <- as.numeric(SCENARIO.CFG$MIC.grid)
SCENARIO.P.CFG <- as.numeric(SCENARIO.CFG$P)
SCENARIO.NTHETA.CFG <- as.integer(SCENARIO.CFG$nTheta)
if (length(SCENARIO.INPUT.CFG) != 1L ||
    !nzchar(SCENARIO.INPUT.CFG) ||
    !length(SCENARIO.D.CFG) ||
    !length(SCENARIO.Q.CFG) ||
    length(SCENARIO.P.CFG) != 1L ||
    !is.finite(SCENARIO.P.CFG) ||
    isTRUE(SCENARIO.CFG$D50)) {
  stop("scenarios.PSA.qmd: unsupported scenario configuration.",
       call. = FALSE)
}

SCENARIO.PATH <- file.path(root, "data", "records", "scenarios")
SCENARIO.DIRS <- list.dirs(
  SCENARIO.PATH,
  recursive = FALSE,
  full.names = TRUE
)
if (!length(SCENARIO.DIRS)) {
  stop("scenarios.PSA.qmd: no generated scenarios were found.", call. = FALSE)
}

SCENARIO.INVENTORY <- data.table::rbindlist(lapply(
  SCENARIO.DIRS,
  function(PATH.sc) {
    ScenarioID <- basename(PATH.sc)
    JSON.FILES <- list.files(
      PATH.sc,
      pattern = "\\.json$",
      full.names = TRUE
    )
    JSON.FILE <- file.path(PATH.sc, sprintf("%s.json", ScenarioID))
    PSW.FILE <- file.path(PATH.sc, "PSW.csv")
    if (length(JSON.FILES) != 1L ||
        !file.exists(JSON.FILE) ||
        !identical(
          normalizePath(JSON.FILES, mustWork = TRUE),
          normalizePath(JSON.FILE, mustWork = TRUE)
        ) ||
        !file.exists(PSW.FILE)) {
      stop(sprintf(
        "scenarios.PSA.qmd: incomplete scenario product %s.",
        ScenarioID
      ), call. = FALSE)
    }
    J <- jsonlite::read_json(JSON.FILE, simplifyVector = TRUE)
    REQ <- c(
      "InputID", "OutputID", "D", "MIC", "P", "Fmax", "xi",
      "D50", "D100", "nTheta", "TargetUnits"
    )
    if (length(setdiff(REQ, names(J))) ||
        !identical(as.character(J$OutputID), ScenarioID)) {
      stop(sprintf(
        "scenarios.PSA.qmd: invalid sidecar for %s.",
        ScenarioID
      ), call. = FALSE)
    }
    data.table::data.table(
      ScenarioID = ScenarioID,
      PATH.sc = PATH.sc,
      PSW.file = PSW.FILE,
      InputID = as.character(J$InputID),
      D = as.numeric(J$D),
      MIC = as.numeric(J$MIC),
      P = as.numeric(J$P),
      Fmax = as.numeric(J$Fmax),
      xi = as.numeric(J$xi),
      D50 = isTRUE(J$D50),
      D100 = isTRUE(J$D100),
      nTheta = as.integer(J$nTheta),
      TargetUnits = as.character(J$TargetUnits)
    )
  }
), use.names = TRUE)

SCENARIO.EXPECTED <- data.table::CJ(
  D = SCENARIO.D.CFG,
  MIC = SCENARIO.Q.CFG,
  P = SCENARIO.P.CFG,
  unique = TRUE
)
SCENARIO.ACTUAL <- unique(
  SCENARIO.INVENTORY[, .(D, MIC, P)]
)
if (nrow(data.table::fsetdiff(SCENARIO.EXPECTED, SCENARIO.ACTUAL)) ||
    nrow(data.table::fsetdiff(SCENARIO.ACTUAL, SCENARIO.EXPECTED)) ||
    any(SCENARIO.INVENTORY$InputID != SCENARIO.INPUT.CFG) ||
    data.table::uniqueN(SCENARIO.INVENTORY$Fmax) != 1L ||
    any(abs(SCENARIO.INVENTORY$xi - 0.05) > 1e-12) ||
    any(SCENARIO.INVENTORY$D50) ||
    any(SCENARIO.INVENTORY$D100) ||
    any(SCENARIO.INVENTORY$nTheta != SCENARIO.NTHETA.CFG) ||
    data.table::uniqueN(SCENARIO.INVENTORY$TargetUnits) != 1L) {
  stop("scenarios.PSA.qmd: scenario sidecars do not satisfy the configured contract.",
       call. = FALSE)
}

SCENARIO.AUDIT <- data.table::fread(
  file.path(root, "data", "audit", "summary.csv")
)
SCENARIO.AUDIT.REQ <- c("ScenarioID", "PASS")
if (length(setdiff(SCENARIO.AUDIT.REQ, names(SCENARIO.AUDIT))) ||
    !setequal(
      SCENARIO.AUDIT$ScenarioID,
      SCENARIO.INVENTORY$ScenarioID
    ) ||
    any(is.na(SCENARIO.AUDIT$PASS)) ||
    any(!SCENARIO.AUDIT$PASS)) {
  stop("scenarios.PSA.qmd: the scenario audit is incomplete or not fully satisfactory.",
       call. = FALSE)
}

SCENARIO.COMPONENTS <- c("H1", "H2", "UP")
SCENARIO.PSA.COLS <- paste0("PSA.", SCENARIO.COMPONENTS)
SCENARIO.PSA.LIST <- vector("list", nrow(SCENARIO.INVENTORY))
SCENARIO.RECORDS.REF <- NULL
SCENARIO.PERIODS.REF <- NULL
for (i in seq_len(nrow(SCENARIO.INVENTORY))) {
  ROW <- SCENARIO.INVENTORY[i]
  PS <- data.table::fread(ROW$PSW.file)
  REQ <- c("RecordID", "xi", "Tn", SCENARIO.PSA.COLS)
  if (length(setdiff(REQ, names(PS))) ||
      anyDuplicated(PS, by = c("RecordID", "xi", "Tn")) ||
      any(!is.finite(PS$xi)) ||
      any(abs(PS$xi - ROW$xi) > 1e-12) ||
      any(!is.finite(PS$Tn)) ||
      any(PS$Tn < 0) ||
      any(!is.finite(
        PS[, unlist(.SD), .SDcols = SCENARIO.PSA.COLS]
      )) ||
      any(PS[, unlist(.SD), .SDcols = SCENARIO.PSA.COLS] <= 0)) {
    stop(sprintf(
      "scenarios.PSA.qmd: invalid PSA schema in %s.",
      ROW$ScenarioID
    ), call. = FALSE)
  }
  RECORDS <- sort(unique(as.character(PS$RecordID)))
  PERIODS <- sort(unique(as.numeric(PS$Tn)))
  if (is.null(SCENARIO.RECORDS.REF)) {
    SCENARIO.RECORDS.REF <- RECORDS
    SCENARIO.PERIODS.REF <- PERIODS
  } else if (!identical(RECORDS, SCENARIO.RECORDS.REF) ||
             !identical(PERIODS, SCENARIO.PERIODS.REF)) {
    stop("scenarios.PSA.qmd: record population or period grid changes between scenarios.",
         call. = FALSE)
  }
  LONG <- data.table::melt(
    PS,
    id.vars = c("RecordID", "xi", "Tn"),
    measure.vars = SCENARIO.PSA.COLS,
    variable.name = "OCID",
    value.name = "PSA"
  )
  LONG[, OCID := sub("^PSA\\.", "", as.character(OCID))]
  AUX <- LONG[, .(
    q50 = stats::median(PSA),
    N = data.table::uniqueN(RecordID)
  ), by = .(OCID, Tn)]
  AUX[, `:=`(
    ScenarioID = as.character(ROW$ScenarioID),
    D = as.numeric(ROW$D),
    MIC = as.numeric(ROW$MIC),
    P = as.numeric(ROW$P)
  )]
  data.table::setcolorder(
    AUX,
    c("ScenarioID", "D", "MIC", "P", "OCID", "Tn", "q50", "N")
  )
  SCENARIO.PSA.LIST[[i]] <- AUX
}

SCENARIO_PSA <- data.table::rbindlist(
  SCENARIO.PSA.LIST,
  use.names = TRUE
)
if (!setequal(unique(SCENARIO_PSA$OCID), SCENARIO.COMPONENTS) ||
    anyDuplicated(
      SCENARIO_PSA,
      by = c("ScenarioID", "OCID", "Tn")
    ) ||
    any(!is.finite(SCENARIO_PSA$q50)) ||
    any(SCENARIO_PSA$q50 <= 0) ||
    data.table::uniqueN(SCENARIO_PSA$N) != 1L) {
  stop("scenarios.PSA.qmd: aggregated scenario PSA is inconsistent.",
       call. = FALSE)
}

SCENARIO_INPUT_ID <- unique(SCENARIO.INVENTORY$InputID)
SCENARIO_P <- unique(SCENARIO.INVENTORY$P)
SCENARIO_CHARGES <- sort(unique(SCENARIO.INVENTORY$MIC))
SCENARIO_N_RECORDS <- unique(SCENARIO_PSA$N)
SCENARIO_TARGET_UNITS <- unique(SCENARIO.INVENTORY$TargetUnits)
```

::: {.panel-tabset .full-width}

```{r}
#| results: asis
#| echo: false
#| include: !expr knitr::is_html_output()
for (.OCID in SCENARIO.COMPONENTS) {
  cat(sprintf("\n#### %s\n\n", .OCID))
  cat("::: {.panel-tabset .full-width}\n")
  for (.MIC in SCENARIO_CHARGES) {
    cat(sprintf(
      "\n##### $Q=%s\\,\\mathrm{kg}$\n\n",
      format(.MIC, trim = TRUE, scientific = FALSE)
    ))
    .CAPTION <- sprintf(
      CAP,
      SCENARIO_INPUT_ID,
      formatC(SCENARIO_P, format = "f", digits = 2L),
      format(.MIC, trim = TRUE, scientific = FALSE),
      SCENARIO_N_RECORDS
    )
    NGR::knitBlock(
      path = "/_fig/scenarios.PSA.cell.qmd",
      stem = sprintf(
        "scenarios-psa-%s-q%s",
        tolower(.OCID),
        gsub("[.]", "p", format(.MIC, trim = TRUE))
      ),
      labels = "rewrite",
      vars = list(
        OCID.target = .OCID,
        MIC.target = .MIC,
        CAPTION = .CAPTION
      ),
      root = root
    )
  }
  cat("\n:::\n")
}
```

rm(list = intersect(c(
  "CAP", "SCENARIO.ACTUAL", "SCENARIO.AUDIT", "SCENARIO.AUDIT.REQ",
  "SCENARIO.CFG", "SCENARIO.CFG.FILE", "SCENARIO.CFG.REQ",
  "SCENARIO.D.CFG", "SCENARIO.DIRS", "SCENARIO.EXPECTED",
  "SCENARIO.INPUT.CFG", "SCENARIO.INVENTORY", "SCENARIO.NTHETA.CFG",
  "SCENARIO.P.CFG", "SCENARIO.PATH", "SCENARIO.PERIODS.REF",
  "SCENARIO.PSA.COLS", "SCENARIO.PSA.LIST", "SCENARIO.Q.CFG",
  "SCENARIO.RECORDS.REF", ".CAPTION", ".MIC", ".OCID", "i", "LONG",
  "AUX", "PERIODS", "PS", "RECORDS", "REQ", "ROW"
), ls()))
